lectures.title: Time and Space Complexity of Binary Search Tree

cues.en: All right.
In this lecture we are going to look at big picture of time and space complexity of binary search tree.
Now whenever we are creating the binary search tree we are creating an empty binary search tree.
So creation will take one time complexity and o one space complexity.
Now, when it comes to the inserting a new node to the binary search tree, the time complexity is going
to be o n because we need to find the next available place in the binary search tree.
But that's why in the first case, it's going to take all n time complexity.
Now, every time we are inserting a new node, that's why the space complexity is o one.
Now we know that when we are traversing the binary search tree we have different methods.
So here the time complexity for all methods is O one because we have to visit each node one by one.
And the space complexity is O one because here we have implemented the recursive versions.
So when we are implementing the recursive versions it's going to take space in the memory.
That's why the space complexity is o n.
Now when we are searching for a node, in the worst case it's going to take on time complexity.
But the space complexity is o one, because here an additional memory is not required to perform this
operation.
Now, deleting a node from the binary search tree will take on time complexity.
And space complexity is also on because here again we are using the recursive approach.
That's why it's going to take on space complexity.
Now with this lecture we have come to the end of the binary search tree section.
So hopefully everything is clear.
